visual.general_description: Two line graphs side by side: SF-36 quality-of-life domain scores (A) and the Burke Fahn Marsden dystonia rating scale (B) across the same six time categories.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A shows eight colored SF-36 domain series under the title "Quality of life" and panel B shows one blue series under the title "Burke Fahn Marsden Rating Scale". Both share the printed categories Preop, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year, 3 years and 13 years. No data labels are printed and no unit or axis title is printed on either vertical axis.

panels.general_description: Line graph titled "Quality of life" with eight colored series, one for each SF-36 domain named in the legend, plotted across six labeled time categories.
panels.detailed_description: A line graph with the printed title "Quality of life". The vertical axis has no printed label and shows the tick labels 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 and 120. The horizontal axis has no printed label and shows the categories Preop, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year, 3 years and 13 years. The legend below the plot names eight series with colored line samples: Physical function (blue), Role Physical (orange), Bodily Pain (gray), General Health (yellow), Vitality (light blue), Social Function (green), Role Emotional (dark navy) and Mental Health (dark brown-red); a ninth short gray-black legend sample has no printed name. The plotted points are connected by straight line segments with no markers and no printed data labels. Qualitatively, most series change direction at least once across the categories rather than moving in one direction, the lines cross each other repeatedly, and the spread between series looks narrower in the middle categories than at the left and right ends. The panel letter A is printed at the upper left.

visual.general_description: Two power-spectrum line plots of tremor accelerometer recordings: one titled "Tremor DBS OFF" with a single tall narrow peak and printed annotations, and one titled "Tremor DBS ON" without a tall peak.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A ("Tremor DBS OFF") carries three red arrows with printed annotations for peak frequency, peak amplitude and half-peak bandwidth; panel B ("Tremor DBS ON") has no annotations and no tall narrow peak. Both plots share the y-axis label "g^2*s" with the same printed ticks and the x-axis label "1/s" with ticks 0 through 18.

panels.general_description: Spectrum plot titled "Tremor DBS OFF" with one tall narrow peak and three red-arrow annotations.
panels.detailed_description: A line plot titled "Tremor DBS OFF" on a white background with a blue spectrum trace. The vertical axis label is "g^2*s" with printed tick labels 2e-005, 6e-005, 0.0001, 0.00014, 0.00018, 0.00022, 0.00026 and 0.0003; the horizontal axis label is "1/s" with integer tick labels 0 through 18. The trace shows one tall, narrow single peak at a low frequency with smaller bumps after it and a trace that flattens toward the right. Three red arrows point to the peak and its width with printed annotations: "Peak frequency 3 Hz", "Peak amplitude 0.00024" and "Half-peak bandwidth 0.5". The panel letter A is printed at the upper left.

evidence.quote: (A,B) represent accelerometer-based tremor recordings with DBS OFF, and DBS ON DBS (Left GPi, C+ 1-, 3V, 180 PW, 60 Hz; Right GPi, C+ 1-, 3V; 180 PW; 60 Hz), wash-out and wash-in intervals were 30 min respectively.
